production_mode.operation_policy: One distinct built-in imagegen call per ingredient. Obvious occupancy failures were revised on the single causal axis of subject scale only. Approved 1254x1254 tool-native squares were deterministically resampled to the locked 1536x1536 delivery canvas with ffmpeg Lanczos, without crop or content change. Final delivery outputs were inspected at original detail with view_image.
